   487→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)

   497→
   498→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   499→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   500→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   501→	}

   504→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {

   512→		}
   513→	}
   514→
   515→	// Create context file before saving changes
   516→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   517→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, entireSessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   518→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   519→	}

   521→
   522→	// Get git author from local/global config
   523→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   524→	if err != nil {
   525→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   526→	}
   527→
   528→	// Get the configured strategy
   529→	strat := GetStrategy()
   530→
   531→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (auto-installs git hook, gitignore, etc. if needed)
   532→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   533→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	// Get agent type from session state (set during InitializeSession)
   537→	var agentType string
   538→	if sessionState != nil {
   539→		agentType = sessionState.AgentType
   540→	}
   541→
   542→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at checkpoint start)
   543→	var transcriptUUIDAtStart string
   544→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   545→	if preState != nil {
   546→		transcriptUUIDAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptUUID
   547→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptLineCount
   548→	}
   549→
   550→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   551→	var tokenUsage *checkpoint.TokenUsage
   552→	if transcriptPath != "" {

   554→		subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), entireSessionID, "subagents")

   558→		} else {

   561→	}

   563→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   564→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{

   585→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create

   610→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(entireSessionID); err != nil {

   617→// handlePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   618→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   619→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   620→func handlePostTodo() error {
   621→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   622→	if err != nil {
   623→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   624→	}
   625→
   626→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   627→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   628→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   629→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   630→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   631→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   632→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   633→	)
   634→
   635→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   636→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   637→	if !found {
   638→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   639→		return nil
   640→	}
   641→
   642→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   643→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   644→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   645→		return nil
   646→	}
   647→
   648→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   649→	modified, newFiles, deleted, err := DetectChangedFiles()
   650→	if err != nil {
   651→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   652→		return nil
   653→	}
   654→
   655→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   656→	if len(modified) == 0 && len(newFiles) == 0 && len(deleted) == 0 {
   657→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   658→		return nil
   659→	}
   660→
   661→	// Get git author
   662→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   663→	if err != nil {
   664→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   665→		return nil
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	// Get the active strategy
   669→	strat := GetStrategy()
   670→
   671→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   672→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   673→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   674→		return nil
   675→	}
   676→
   677→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   678→	sessionID := paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   679→	if sessionID == "" {
   680→		sessionID = input.SessionID
   681→	}
   682→	entireSessionID := currentSessionIDWithFallback(sessionID)
   683→
   684→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   685→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(entireSessionID, taskToolUseID)
   686→
   687→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   688→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   689→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   690→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   691→	if todoContent == "" {
   692→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   693→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   694→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   695→		if todoCount > 0 {
   696→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   697→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   698→		}
   699→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   700→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   701→	}
   702→
   703→	// Get agent type from session state
   704→	var agentType string
   705→	if sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(entireSessionID); loadErr == nil && sessionState != nil {
   706→		agentType = sessionState.AgentType
   707→	}
   708→
   709→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   710→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   711→		SessionID:           entireSessionID,
   712→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   713→		ModifiedFiles:       modified,
   714→		NewFiles:            newFiles,
   715→		DeletedFiles:        deleted,
   716→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   717→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   718→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   719→		IsIncremental:       true,
   720→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   721→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   722→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   723→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   724→		AgentType:           agentType,
   725→	}
   726→
   727→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   728→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   729→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   730→		return nil
   731→	}
   732→
   733→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   734→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   735→	return nil
   736→}
